usage_notice: Research summaries/paraphrases only, not wholesale copies of original pages. Confirm time-sensitive claims and obtain university editorial approval before publication. No current tuition/deadline/accreditation data is asserted.
provenance_note: Sources originate on ECU public website; page claims may be dated and must be checked against current policy.

records.title: ECU university profile
records.summary: The Egyptian Chinese University was established under Egyptian Presidential Decree No. 118 of 2013. Its published profile emphasizes applied technology, production-linked learning, innovation, and transfer of relevant Chinese experience.
key_facts: Emphasis on technological and productive education
Two Cairo campuses described in the official profile

records.title: University mission
records.summary: ECU presents its mission as preparing graduates with professional and social competencies suited to changing labor markets, using research, productive education and practical engagement with industry.

records.title: University vision
records.summary: ECU aims to be a productive, technology-based university distinguished in research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and societal contribution.

records.title: Strategic objectives
records.summary: Its stated objectives cover institutional capacity, teaching and learning, research and innovation, community and international cooperation, and continuous quality improvement.

records.title: Egypt–China academic cooperation
records.summary: The institutional profile discusses collaboration with universities in China, including academic program design, exchanges, research and training; partner status and current arrangements should be reconfirmed before prominent claims.
records.editorial_note: Confirm current active agreements; source uses historical statements.

records.title: Egyptian Secondary School Certificate
records.summary: Applicants must satisfy the minimum entry percentages announced by the competent private-university authority. Verify current thresholds for the relevant admissions cycle.
documents: National ID copy (Egyptian applicants) or passport
Six recent passport photos with a white background
Military forms for eligible Egyptian male applicants
records.freshness: Minimum percentages vary by cycle; no threshold included.

records.title: Secondary certificates from Arab countries
records.summary: The official guide distinguishes scientific and non-scientific certificate pathways for different faculties and adds country-specific authentication and supporting-document requirements.
highlights: Scientific track specified for Physical Therapy, Pharmacy, and Engineering and Technology
Non-scientific track specified for Economics and International Trade
Some countries have additional education-verification or cultural-attaché requirements
records.freshness: Faculty eligibility and required forms require current admission-office confirmation.

records.title: IGCSE admissions
records.summary: The official requirements cover qualifying O-Level subjects and, for some faculties, AS/A-Level Mathematics; they also describe certification and document authentication.
highlights: Eight qualifying subjects specified for several faculties
Engineering requirements include additional Mathematics qualifications
Minimum grade requirements and allowed exam sessions are specified on the source page
records.freshness: Check the current admission cycle and faculty-specific rules.

records.title: American Diploma admissions
records.summary: The official guidance describes eligible high-school subjects, transcript authentication, relevant standardized test records, and proof of schooling.
records.freshness: Standardized-test rules and current requirements must be rechecked.

records.title: International Baccalaureate admissions
records.summary: The official admissions page specifies six IB subjects, including three higher-level subjects, a minimum of 24 points, and faculty-related subject requirements.
highlights: Six subjects, with three at Higher Level
Minimum overall score stated as 24 out of 45
Additional Higher Level requirements for some faculties
records.freshness: Review with current ECU admissions office before publishing as current policy.

records.title: Abitur admissions
records.summary: The official guidance requires completion of Grade 12, an academic transcript with specified subjects, and authenticated/translated documents.
records.freshness: Confirm acceptance and document rules for the current cycle.
